summary: Today is NOW signed with a small double motion: two bent hands (or Y hands) dropping down in front of you, twice.
handshape: Bent hands or Y hands, palms up
steps: Hold both hands in front of you, palms up, slightly cupped.
Drop them down a few inches, twice.
Put it at the start of the sentence: TODAY I WORK.
note: Time goes first in ASL. Set the day, then say what happens on it.
mistakes: A single big drop with a firm stop, which reads as NOW, meaning 'right now.'
